series.title: 数据库容量评审：余量、查询优化与分片取舍
series.service: orders platform / PostgreSQL primary and replicas
series.premise: 订单平台使用6TB、可用上限8TB，每月净增约200GB。受保护的20%存储预留使可消耗增长空间只有400GB。CPU峰值68%，交易延迟达标但报表扫描占用I/O，需要比较扩容、优化与分片。
series.outcome: 批准为主库和副本准备存储扩容并确认交付，先在隔离环境与小范围只读报表试点查询优化，不立即生产分片。垂直扩容作为经过压测和切换评审的备用方案；分片保留研究但不承诺工期收益。确定验收、回退、容量阈值、负责人和两周复查。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 包含运行维护与工程投入的总拥有成本

recycling.note: 未来候选不计实际出现；本文件只复现p001-p350或本文件前段定义，不依赖并行草稿。

dialogues.title: 预测不是测量事实
dialogues.premise: 容量评审开场，用历史净增长和未来活动假设建立预测。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别历史数据、预测及不确定范围。

lines.en: Our growth forecast assumes current retention. Net storage grows two hundred gigabytes monthly.
lines.zh: 增长预测假设当前保留规则不变，存储每月净增两百GB。

lines.en: Is that measured growth or projection? Include how many months you sampled.
lines.zh: 这是测量增长还是预测？说明抽样了几个月。

lines.en: Measured across the last six months. Campaign demand is a separate assumption.
lines.zh: 过去六个月的测量，活动需求是单独的假设。

lines.en: Just to confirm, net after retention, right? Don't subtract those deletions twice.
lines.zh: 确认一下，是保留清理后的净值，对吧？别把删除重复扣除。

lines.en: Exactly. A campaign could change the slope. Show a high-growth case as well.
lines.zh: 对，活动可能改变增长斜率，也展示高增长情况。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis allows a larger burst. Maybe three times normal campaign writes.
lines.zh: 当前假设允许更大突发，活动写入可能为平时三倍。

lines.en: That's not three times monthly storage automatically. Burst duration matters for that estimate.
lines.zh: 这不自动等于月存储三倍，突发持续时间影响估计。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for campaign inputs? One action item is verified duration.
lines.zh: 好，活动输入预计什么时候拿到？一个行动项是核实持续时间。

lines.en: I'll ask business owners this afternoon. We shouldn't invent an exact demand curve.
lines.zh: 今天下午我问业务负责人，不能编一个精确需求曲线。

lines.en: So, I've got bandwidth for scenarios. First compare today's actual performance baseline.
lines.zh: 那我有精力做情景分析，先对比今天实际性能基线。

dialogues.title: CPU不是唯一瓶颈
dialogues.premise: 增长口径确定，核对峰值CPU、交易延迟和报表磁盘压力。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出不同业务指标不能混为一个平均值。

lines.en: The peak load baseline shows sixty-eight percent CPU. Transaction latency remains within target.
lines.zh: 峰值基线显示CPU百分之六十八，交易延迟仍达标。

lines.en: Which percentile and which request class? An average could hide busy periods.
lines.zh: 哪个百分位、哪类请求？平均值可能掩盖繁忙时段。

lines.en: Transaction p ninety-five is one-forty milliseconds. Its target is two hundred milliseconds.
lines.zh: 交易p95是一百四十毫秒，目标两百毫秒。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reports measured separately, right? They aren't meeting that same target.
lines.zh: 确认一下，报表单独测，对吧？它不是满足同一个指标。

lines.en: Correct, reports reach nearly two seconds. Their scans coincide with disk queues.
lines.zh: 对，报表接近两秒，扫描与磁盘队列上升重叠。

lines.en: We can't rule that out as contention. Maybe a larger CPU won't help enough.
lines.zh: 不能排除资源争用，也许更多CPU帮助不够。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on I/O ceilings. Instance bandwidth and storage limits differ.
lines.zh: 我关注I/O上限，实例带宽和存储限制是两回事。

lines.en: The growth forecast increases both workloads. But it doesn't prove CPU saturation yet.
lines.zh: 增长预测会增加两类负载，但还不能证明CPU将饱和。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is avoidable scan pressure. Let's inspect the query before sizing.
lines.zh: 当前假设是可避免的扫描压力，估算规格前先查查询。

lines.en: Okay, keep that distinction in the notes. We need capacity and efficiency together.
lines.zh: 好，记录这种区分，容量和效率一起考虑。

dialogues.title: 扫描合理吗，筛选能下推吗
dialogues.premise: 交易达标但报表I/O压力高，查看查询计划及筛选行为。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分合理全扫和可避免的应用侧筛选。

lines.en: The report does a full table scan. It filters dates in application code.
lines.zh: 报表全表扫描，在应用代码里筛日期。

lines.en: Could that filter move into SQL? Keep date boundaries and timezone semantics identical.
lines.zh: 筛选能移到SQL里吗？日期边界和时区语义要相同。

lines.en: Yes, existing date indexes may help. Our working hypothesis needs representative query tests.
lines.zh: 可以，现有日期索引可能有用，当前假设需要代表性查询测试。

lines.en: Okay, test broad ranges too, right? A full scan isn't always wrong.
lines.zh: 好，也测宽范围，对吧？全扫不总是错的。

lines.en: Exactly, selectivity changes the right plan. Don't force indexes for every tenant.
lines.zh: 对，选择性会改变合理计划，别强制每个租户用索引。

lines.en: The smoke test checks output totals. Maybe date truncation needs special boundary cases.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试核对输出总额，日期截断可能需要特殊边界用例。

lines.en: Compare with the peak load baseline. A quiet test can exaggerate gains.
lines.zh: 与峰值基线对比，安静环境测试会夸大收益。

lines.en: Sharding immediately? Let's park that for now. What's the ETA for query evidence?
lines.zh: 立即分片先放一边，查询证据预计什么时候有？

lines.en: Two days for isolated load comparisons. Include large tenants and concurrent writes.
lines.zh: 两天完成隔离负载对比，包括大租户和并发写入。

lines.en: So, optimize before claiming hardware savings. Growth still needs its own storage plan.
lines.zh: 那先优化再谈省硬件，增长仍需要独立存储计划。

dialogues.title: 两TB空闲不等于都能消耗
dialogues.premise: 查询优化可降低I/O，但净数据增长仍占存储，需要明确预留空间。
dialogues.listeningTask: 算清空闲、受保护预留和可用于增长的空间。

lines.en: Storage headroom is two terabytes physically. Six used, eight available, same decimal units.
lines.zh: 物理空闲两TB，已用六TB、可用八TB，都是十进制单位。

lines.en: How much of that is protected reserve? Temporary operations need space as well.
lines.zh: 其中多少是受保护预留？临时操作也需要空间。

lines.en: Twenty percent reserved, one-point-six terabytes today. That leaves four hundred gigabytes spendable.
lines.zh: 预留百分之二十，现在是一点六TB，可消耗空间剩四百GB。

lines.en: Just to confirm, about two months, right? At the measured net growth rate.
lines.zh: 确认一下，大约两个月，对吧？按测得的净增长率。

lines.en: Yes, before touching that protected reserve. Campaign growth could shorten it considerably.
lines.zh: 是，指触及受保护预留前，活动增长可能明显缩短时间。

lines.en: Our retention policy already informs growth forecast. We can't count unapproved deletion savings.
lines.zh: 保留规则已经计入预测，不能算未经批准的删除收益。

lines.en: Replica storage needs the same review. A bigger primary with undersized replicas fails.
lines.zh: 副本存储也要同样评审，主库变大而副本不足会失败。

lines.en: Okay, storage ordering is an action item. What's the ETA for delivery confirmation?
lines.zh: 好，申请存储是一个行动项，预计什么时候确认交付？

lines.en: Tomorrow for the supplier's delivery estimate. Actual provisioning may take three weeks.
lines.zh: 明天拿供应方交付估计，实际开通可能要三周。

lines.en: So, approve preparation without waiting for queries. Efficiency won't erase retained order growth.
lines.zh: 那批准准备，不必等查询优化，效率改善不会消除保留订单增长。

dialogues.title: 更大实例能买时间，也有上限
dialogues.premise: 存储扩容需提前准备，比较更大实例对性能的帮助及切换代价。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出CPU、I/O和切换窗口必须分别验证。

lines.en: Vertical scaling adds CPU and memory. It may not lift storage I/O limits.
lines.zh: 升单实例规格增加CPU和内存，但不一定提高存储I/O上限。

lines.en: It could buy us time for peaks. But our disk queues need measurement.
lines.zh: 它能为高峰争取时间，但磁盘队列需要测量。

lines.en: I favor it as a fallback. Maybe query gains won't cover campaign load.
lines.zh: 我倾向把它作为备用，查询收益可能不足以覆盖活动负载。

lines.en: Just to confirm, not approved execution, right? We still need a maintenance window.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不是批准执行，对吧？仍需要维护窗口。

lines.en: And a tested rollback trigger too. Instance changes can require restart or switchover.
lines.zh: 也需要验证过的回退触发条件，实例变更可能要求重启或切换。

lines.en: Storage headroom still needs separate expansion. More memory won't store another year's data.
lines.zh: 存储余量仍需独立扩容，更多内存不能存下一年的数据。

lines.en: The next size has a finite ceiling. We shouldn't promise unlimited runway here.
lines.zh: 下一规格也有上限，不能承诺无限增长空间。

lines.en: Okay, model one step and its cost. Compare it with the sharding option.
lines.zh: 好，估算升一级及成本，与分片方案比较。

lines.en: Include replica sizing and standby readiness. A writer upgrade isn't the whole fleet.
lines.zh: 包括副本规格和备用就绪，升级写库不是整个集群。

lines.en: So, run the larger-instance load test. Keep it reversible before changing production.
lines.zh: 那跑更大实例负载测试，改生产前确保可回退。

dialogues.title: 分片键解决分布，不解决所有查询
dialogues.premise: 垂直扩容是有限备用，讨论按租户分片的长期可能性。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出大租户热点、跨分片查询和事务取舍。

lines.en: Tenant ID is our proposed shard key. Most order operations stay within tenants.
lines.zh: 建议用租户ID作分片键，大多数订单操作在租户内。

lines.en: What happens to the largest tenant? One hot shard could remain the bottleneck.
lines.zh: 最大租户怎么办？一个热点分片可能仍是瓶颈。

lines.en: Yes, tenant sizes are very uneven. Our working hypothesis needs distribution simulation first.
lines.zh: 是，租户规模很不均，当前假设需要先模拟分布。

lines.en: Just to confirm, cross-tenant reports exist, right? Those won't become magically cheaper.
lines.zh: 确认一下，有跨租户报表，对吧？它们不会神奇地更便宜。

lines.en: Correct, fan-out adds coordination and latency. Global totals need a separate aggregation design.
lines.zh: 对，多分片查询增加协调和延迟，全局汇总需要独立聚合设计。

lines.en: Maybe tenant routing covers normal writes. Cross-tenant adjustments still need explicit transaction rules.
lines.zh: 租户路由可能覆盖普通写入，跨租户调整仍需明确事务规则。

lines.en: And rebalancing needs operational ownership too. More databases mean more recovery procedures.
lines.zh: 重平衡也需要运维负责人，数据库更多就有更多恢复流程。

lines.en: Okay, immediate sharding? Let's park that. Do we have bandwidth for research?
lines.zh: 好，立即分片先放一边，有精力做研究吗？

lines.en: Limited bandwidth, not an eight-week commitment. Compare vertical scaling with realistic staffing.
lines.zh: 精力有限，不是承诺八周完成，与垂直扩容比较时要用实际人手。

lines.en: So, prototype distribution on synthetic data. We shouldn't promise savings before that.
lines.zh: 那先用合成数据做分布原型，之前不承诺收益。

dialogues.title: 双写不是免费的安全网
dialogues.premise: 租户分片仍需研究，比较数据迁移、双写和回退风险。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别原型、生产迁移和可验证的回退门槛。

lines.en: Migration risk includes missed and duplicate writes. Dual writing isn't automatic consistency protection.
lines.zh: 迁移风险包括漏写和重复写，双写不是自动一致性保护。

lines.en: Agreed, retries and ordering need explicit design. We don't have that implementation today.
lines.zh: 同意，重试和顺序需要明确设计，目前没有实现。

lines.en: Changing a shard key can move data. Recovery and reconciliation must cover each move.
lines.zh: 改分片键可能搬迁数据，恢复和对账必须覆盖每次移动。

lines.en: Just to confirm, research stays isolated, right? No production dual-write experiment this week.
lines.zh: 确认一下，研究保持隔离，对吧？本周不做生产双写实验。

lines.en: Yes, a smoke test isn't sufficient. We need failure and replay scenarios.
lines.zh: 是，冒烟测试不够，需要失败和回放场景。

lines.en: The rollback trigger needs data convergence evidence. Maybe reversing routing alone loses updates.
lines.zh: 回退触发条件需要数据收敛证据，单纯反向改路由可能丢更新。

lines.en: Exactly. Reversibility has to be demonstrated. It isn't just keeping the old database.
lines.zh: 对，必须证明可逆，不只是保留旧数据库。

lines.en: Okay, aggressive cutover dates? Let's park that. Storage deadlines are sooner than research.
lines.zh: 好，激进切换日期先放一边，存储期限比研究更近。

lines.en: Separate immediate capacity from long-term redesign. We can fund research without choosing migration.
lines.zh: 短期容量与长期重构分开，可以资助研究而不决定迁移。

lines.en: So, document unknowns and acceptance criteria. Costs come next, including this engineering work.
lines.zh: 那记录未知项和验收条件，接下来算成本，包括这些工程工作。

dialogues.title: 不只比较月租
dialogues.premise: 技术与迁移边界明确，对比基础设施、人力和维护成本。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出估价口径、共同存储成本和工期不确定性。

lines.en: Total cost of ownership includes engineering. The monthly bill isn't the whole comparison.
lines.zh: 总拥有成本包括工程投入，月账单不是全部比较。

lines.en: Vertical scaling adds eighteen hundred monthly. That's fleet cost, not just primary.
lines.zh: 垂直扩容每月增加一千八百，这是整个集群，不只是主库。

lines.en: Shards add roughly twenty-four hundred monthly. Engineering could take eight weeks or longer.
lines.zh: 分片每月约增加两千四百，工程可能八周或更久。

lines.en: Just to confirm, estimates, not quotes, right? And no guaranteed sharding savings yet.
lines.zh: 确认一下，是估计不是报价，对吧？也没有保证分片省钱。

lines.en: Correct, migration risk increases testing effort. On-call ownership adds ongoing staffing costs.
lines.zh: 对，迁移风险增加测试工作，值班责任增加持续人力成本。

lines.en: Storage expansion adds four hundred monthly separately. Both options still need that capacity.
lines.zh: 存储扩容另每月增加四百，两种方案都仍需这些容量。

lines.en: Query optimization needs about two engineer-weeks. Savings stay provisional until load tests.
lines.zh: 查询优化约需两个人周，压测前收益仍暂估。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for firm quotes? We have bandwidth for one pilot.
lines.zh: 好，明确报价预计何时？我们有精力做一个试点。

lines.en: Tomorrow for infrastructure estimates and lead times. Maybe procurement changes the delivery assumptions.
lines.zh: 明天拿基础设施估价和交付周期，采购可能改变交付假设。

lines.en: So, favor queries plus storage preparation. Keep the larger instance as contingency.
lines.zh: 那倾向查询优化加存储准备，更大实例保留作备用。

dialogues.title: 试点要有真实验收门槛
dialogues.premise: 选择查询优化与存储准备，定义小范围只读报表试点及回退。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住正确性、交易影响和磁盘压力的验收条件。

lines.en: Approve a capacity pilot for reports. Isolated tests first, one region afterward.
lines.zh: 批准报表容量试点，先隔离测试，之后一个区域。

lines.en: Which tenants represent the actual skew? A tiny tenant isn't a useful pilot.
lines.zh: 哪些租户代表实际偏斜？一个小租户不是有效试点。

lines.en: One large and two smaller tenants. I'm on it with the feature switch.
lines.zh: 一个大租户和两个小租户，我负责功能开关。

lines.en: The full table scan should shrink selectively. Broad reports may still scan reasonably.
lines.zh: 选择性高的查询应减少全扫，宽范围报表仍可能合理扫描。

lines.en: Compare against the peak load baseline. Include transaction latency beside report improvements.
lines.zh: 与峰值基线对比，报表收益旁边也列交易延迟。

lines.en: Just to confirm, identical totals required, right? Faster wrong reports fail the pilot.
lines.zh: 确认一下，总额必须相同，对吧？更快但错误的报表算失败。

lines.en: Yes. Lower disk reads are another gate. Keep transaction latency below two hundred.
lines.zh: 是，磁盘读取下降也是门槛，交易延迟保持低于两百毫秒。

lines.en: Incorrect totals are the immediate rollback trigger. Maybe scan savings vary by date range.
lines.zh: 总额错误立即触发回退，扫描收益可能随日期范围变化。

lines.en: And sustained write regression halts expansion. Revert the query switch, preserve evidence.
lines.zh: 持续写回归也停止扩展，回退查询开关并保留证据。

lines.en: Okay, order storage for all nodes now. Pilot success won't postpone that preparation.
lines.zh: 好，现在为所有节点申请存储，试点成功也不推迟准备。

dialogues.title: 短期容量与长期研究各有期限
dialogues.premise: 试点和存储准备获批，分片研究与备用扩容保持独立，确认责任及复查。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出决定、条件批准和未选择方案的区别。

lines.en: Our capacity guardrail protects twenty percent reserve. Alerts use forecast and remaining space.
lines.zh: 容量门槛保护百分之二十预留，告警同时用预测和剩余空间。

lines.en: Storage headroom must cover delivery lead time. Escalate if arrival risks that reserve.
lines.zh: 存储余量必须覆盖交付周期，预计交付触及预留就升级联系。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for delivery? Raj owns confirmations by tomorrow, right?
lines.zh: 交付谁接？Raj明天前负责确认，对吧？

lines.en: My action item is the capacity pilot. Evidence review is due in two weeks.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是容量试点，两周后评审证据。

lines.en: I'll check correctness and comparable load. Maybe campaign inputs change the acceptance range.
lines.zh: 我检查正确性和可比负载，活动输入可能改变验收范围。

lines.en: Yes, I'll update high-growth projections tomorrow. The protected reserve isn't emergency spending permission.
lines.zh: 是，我明天更新高增长预测，受保护预留不是随便应急消耗的许可。

lines.en: I'll test larger-instance fallback this week. Production switching still needs separate approval.
lines.zh: 我本周测试更大实例备用，生产切换仍需单独批准。

lines.en: Okay, sharding stays research, not a commitment. We'll review staffing after distribution results.
lines.zh: 好，分片仍是研究，不是承诺，分布结果出来后再评审人手。

lines.en: Bring both monthly costs and engineering effort. A cheap quote can hide operational expense.
lines.zh: 带月成本和工程投入，便宜报价可能藏着运维支出。

lines.en: So, close the loop in two weeks. No growth assumption becomes fact without evidence.
lines.zh: 那两周后闭环，没有证据就不把增长假设当事实。
